title: Italian Tempeh-Gnocchi Skillet with Broccoli, Snap Peas & Lemon

steps.text: Fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover with a lid and bring to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Once the water in the pot is boiling, add gnocchi and salt. Cook, stirring occasionally, until gnocchi begins to float to the surface, about 3 minutes. Drain in a colander and set aside.
While the gnocchi are cooking, peel, halve, and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic. Place both in a small bowl and set aside.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, halve tempeh lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin strips.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, garlic, tempeh, and spices. Cook, stirring frequently, until tempeh is golden and warmed through, about 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Add broccoli and snap peas to the skillet. Cook, stirring frequently, until tender-crisp, 4-5 minutes.
Zest and juice lemon into the skillet, then add cooked gnocchi and stir to combine. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until gnocchi is warmed through, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide gnocchi, veggies, and tempeh between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
